hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); case "$path" in figures/*.png|figures/*.pdf|./figures/*.png|./figures/*.pdf|*/figures/*.png|*/figures/*.pdf) echo "Blocked: $path is a generated figure. Regenerate via 'uv run python figures/generate_figures.py' instead of editing in place." >&2; exit 2 ;; paper/creative_determinant.pdf|./paper/creative_determinant.pdf|*/paper/creative_determinant.pdf) echo "Blocked: $path is a LaTeX build output. Rebuild from paper/creative_determinant.tex via 'latexmk -pdf' (or pdflatex+bibtex passes). Note: 'make -C paper' only builds the cd_stack diagrams, not the PDF." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$path" in *.py) command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; uv run ruff format "$path" || { rc=$?; echo "[hook] ruff format failed for $path (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 2; }; uv run ruff check --fix "$path" || { rc=$?; echo "[hook] ruff check --fix failed for $path (exit $rc); fix and re-edit" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
